#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

REPORT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {REPORT} not found in workspace")

# --- 1. Create the cover page ---
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)

# Clean professional cover layout
title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

c.setFillColorRGB(0.10, 0.18, 0.33)          # dark navy
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 320, title)

# thin rule under the title
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.10, 0.18, 0.33)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height - 345, width / 2.0 + 150, height - 345)

c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 375, today)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page created: {COVER} (title={title!r}, date={today!r})")

# --- 2. Merge cover page with report.pdf ---
reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# --- 3. Replace report.pdf with the merged document ---
os.replace(OUTPUT, REPORT)
print(f"Merged {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) after cover -> {REPORT}")

# --- 4. Verify ---
final_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
first_text = (final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
print(f"Total pages now: {len(final_reader.pages)}")
print("First page text:")
print(first_text)

ok = "Annual Financial Report" in first_text and today in first_text
print("VERIFY:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("Verification failed: cover content not found on page 1")
